conviction_note: No repricing mechanism found and nothing scheduled in the window. The one finding is a financing overhang: an open $42m ATM, an issuance standstill that expired 2026-10-01, a going-concern company whose estimated Sep-30 cash sits about $7-8m above its $17.5m minimum-liquidity covenant, management saying on 10-07 that it is 'evaluating ways to strengthen the balance sheet', and a precedent of launching an offering into a falling tape (2026-08-13). That makes a discrete supply event inside a two-session window possible but not likely, so the finding is sized small (-1.5). The scaled number is abs 6.5 (between the name's 3.6% median absolute next move and its 10.4% ATR) times a p_up of 42, giving -1.04. The two measurements agree in sign and roughly in size.
bar: This name's own 86 comparable falls (median next close -0.24%, up rate 40.7%, median absolute move 3.6%), its last 12 falls since July (10 of 12 flat or down the next session), and ATR14 of 10.4%, all from the sealed baseline. No usable option chain (unusable_chain, ATM legs not two-sided). Unsourced as an implied move, so sizes are capped.

cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: Second down day after MicroVision's 2026-10-07 virtual business update (moved to 16:00 ET). The update reaffirmed $10-15m of 2026 revenue, gave no contract values and no opex or cash figures, and said management is evaluating its debt structure, lease obligations and non-core asset sales. The stock fell 13.8% on 10-08 and 8.8% to the 15:05 ET screen on 10-09 on 3.4x volume. No new filing or wire story dated 10-09 was found.

Session start time moved to 4:00 PM ET on 2026-10-07

pipeline.next_dated_event: Next monthly partial redemption of the senior secured convertible notes on 2026-11-01 ($3.0m plus 10%, share-settled at the company's election). The Q3 call has no company-announced date (Zacks estimates 2026-11-10). Nothing found dated inside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K over the weekend announcing a debt restructuring with the note holder, or a non-dilutive asset sale, would remove the financing overhang; a launched or priced offering would confirm it.

positioning_check: Short interest 5,689,036 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement (-6.5% vs 08-31), 4.86 days to cover (Nasdaq API, https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/MVIS/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). The series is post the 1-for-15 reverse split, so the ~52-68m pre-August figures are not comparable. Shares outstanding were 30,150,027 at 2026-08-14 per the 13G, before the 6.8m-share August offering and later note conversions, so short interest is roughly 15% of shares. FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into this fall is not observable. JG Global / Johannes Gnauck reported 7.9% on 2026-09-16 (13G). No insider open-market trades in 12 months. No usable skew: the chain is not two-sided; put/call OI is 0.87 on total OI of 1,659.

findings.finding: MicroVision can issue stock inside the window and has reason to. The 45-day issuance standstill from the August offering expired around 2026-10-01. A $42m ATM is open (Deutsche Bank, Mizuho, Craig-Hallum; $41.2m available at 06-30). The 10-Q carries going-concern language. Estimated Sep-30 cash is about $25m against a minimum-liquidity covenant of the lesser of $17.5m or 110% of the notes. On 10-07 management said it is 'evaluating ways to strengthen the balance sheet', and in August it launched a confidentially marketed offering the day after a -18.9% fall.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Both supply routes can act inside the window: ATM sales need only a trading day (10-12 is one), and a confidentially marketed offering can launch and price overnight off the effective June S-3, as on 2026-08-13/14. The window is still dated by those routes, not by an announced event, so this is a probability-weighted overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-08-13: -18.92%, then -40.58% the next session when the $2.50 unit offering (6.8m shares plus warrants, WestPark) priced on 08-14 (sealed baseline events; 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/65770/000149315226038743/form8-k.htm).
findings.why_not_priced: The price holds a disappointing update. It does not hold a dated discrete raise: if a raise were priced in, the stock would sit near a discount to an offer price with the overhang cleared. Shares settled by the note holder each month and possible ATM drip are continuous supply already partly in the tape. A launched deal would be a further step down, on the August precedent of -40%.
findings.independence: The 10-07 press release's balance-sheet language (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/65770/000149315226046140/ex99-1.htm), the ATM prospectus (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/65770/000149315226029854/form424b5.htm) and the August standstill terms (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/65770/000149315226038743/form8-k.htm) are separate documents from the same issuer. Nothing independent of the company confirms that a raise is imminent.

outside_window.finding: Monthly share-settled partial redemption of the senior secured convertible notes ($3.0m plus 10% premium, or 110% of 7% of daily VWAP volume if greater). The next one falls on 2026-11-01 and adds continuous supply.

Nasdaq $1 bid: compliance was regained on 2026-08-26 after the 1-for-15 reverse split. Spot of $1.195 is within 25% of $1, but a new deficiency needs 30 consecutive sessions below $1.
Projected 2027 revenue doubling and a substantial drop in 2027 cash burn, with no figures given.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the moderate 3.4x volume, the high 10.4% ATR, the deep 60-day drawdown and this name's recent run of falls followed by down sessions (10 of the last 12 flat or down). It cuts slightly against the 86-event median of -0.24% and the -10 to -7.5 band prior of +0.59%. It rests on an undated overhang, so it is kept small.
